newsitem.title: GERMANY: Frankfurt air cargo down 0.9 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt air cargo down 0.9 pct in May.

text.p: Air cargo flown to and from Frankfurt airport (FRA) fell 0.9 percent in May year-on-year as companies cut production, airport authority figures showed.

Air cargo tonnage growth declined slightly to 3.1 percent year-on-year growth over the first five months of 1997 compared to 4.1 percent over the first four months, the monthly Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FA) traffic report said.

The three 50-Called "long weekends" caused by public holidays on Thursdays or Mondays last month reduced the number of air cargo shipments through Germany's international airfreight gateway, the report noted.
A reduction in freighter services in order to carry out maintenance work was a further reason for the slight decline in air cargo last month.
Some freighter services were also transferred from Frankfurt to Cologne/Bonn airport with the start of the summer season, FAG said.
